article.body: The UK Defence and Security Accelerator has published guidelines for submitting proposals online, effective September 3rd, 2026. These guidelines outline acceptable use of the UK Defence Innovation (UKDI) online submission service, requiring users to adhere to legal, professional, and responsible standards. The specific groups affected are those submitting proposals to the UKDI. No further details, such as the nature of the proposals or the UKDI's objectives, are provided in the supplied intelligence.
